title: Forge — Session Overview
_comment: Built on the ClickHouse datasource (forge.session_event, docs/12 §5). Filterable by forge.repo.id / forge.user.id / forge.session.status / environment (docs/14 §6). Datasource uid 'forge-clickhouse' is the ClickStack datasource provisioned in §6/prod.

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo_id FROM forge.session_event ORDER BY 1

targets.query: SELECT status, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS c FROM forge.session_event WHERE status IN ('queued','active','failed') AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, status, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS c FROM forge.session_event WHERE ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t, status ORDER BY t

panels.title: p50 / p99 time-to-interactive (ms)
panels._comment: TTI = time from session_started to first prompt.stream span. Derived from the DO-buffered spans (promoted-to-full on failure, docs/14 §4).

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, quantileTDigest(0.5)(duration_ms) AS p50, quantileTDigest(0.99)(duration_ms) AS p99 FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'session_started' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, avg(cost_usd) AS avg_cost, quantileTDigest(0.99)(cost_usd) AS p99_cost FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'cost_event' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
